subtitle: Out Manila · VietJet Air charter
overview: Land in Hanoi and go up to Sapa for Cat Cat Village and Fansipan by mountain railway and cable car. Continue to Hanoi for a city tour and on to Ha Long Bay for a day cruise with buffet lunch and afternoon tea, then fly home in the evening. Four nights in 4★ hotels; this rate includes shopping stops.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Oct 31–Nov 4 2026 to Nov 9–13 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Hanoi – Sapa
items: Fly Manila to Hanoi (VJ 01:35–03:50, reference) and meet the tour guide at the airport
Photo stop at Lao Cai Border Gate
Cat Cat Village, one of the most beautiful villages in Sa Pa
Transfer to the hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Sapa – Hanoi
items: Muong Hoa Mountain Railway to the Fansipan Cable Car Station (round trip)
Fansipan cable car to the Fansipan Peak area (round trip) with panoramic mountain and valley views
Lunch: mountain buffet at Van Sam restaurant
Transfer to the hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Hanoi – Ha Long Bay
items: Hanoi Train Street (subject to local authority permission)
Transfer to the hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay
items: Ha Long Bay day cruise: buffet lunch, cruise among thousands of limestone islands, sundeck with panoramic bay views
Visit Sung Sot Cave, Luon Cave and Titop Island
Afternoon tea while cruising back to the port

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay – Hanoi – Manila
items: Silk and Bamboo Charcoal shop (shopping stop)
Transfer to the airport for the flight back to Manila (VJ 20:10–00:35 +1 day, reference)

placeDesc.Lao Cai Border Gate: The Vietnam–China border gate at Lao Cai, a photo stop on the way up to Sapa.
placeDesc.Cat Cat Village: A Hmong village in the Sapa hills known for terraced scenery, handicrafts and traditional homes.
placeDesc.Cau May Walking Street: A pedestrian street in Sapa town with shops, food stalls and a lively evening atmosphere.
placeDesc.Sapa Church: A stone church in the centre of Sapa town, a landmark of the old French-era resort.
placeDesc.Love Square: The main public square in Sapa town beside the church, used as a meeting and photo spot.
placeDesc.Fansipan: The highest mountain in Indochina; the tour rides the cable car to the peak area for panoramic views.
placeDesc.Muong Hoa Mountain Railway: A modern mountain railway linking Sapa town to the Fansipan cable car station.
placeDesc.Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum: The mausoleum of Vietnam's revolutionary leader on Ba Dinh Square in Hanoi, seen as a photo stop.
placeDesc.Governor-General’s Palace: A French colonial-era palace in Hanoi, viewed from the outside on this tour.
placeDesc.Sung Sot Cave: One of Ha Long Bay's largest caves, with big chambers and rock formations.
placeDesc.Luon Cave: A cave in Ha Long Bay that is typically explored by small boat or kayak.
placeDesc.Titop Island: A small island in Ha Long Bay with a beach and a viewpoint over the bay.
placeDesc.36 Streets: Hanoi's old quarter, a maze of streets traditionally named after the goods once sold there.
placeDesc.Hoan Kiem Lake: A central lake in Hanoi, a popular walking spot beside the old quarter.
